body:
While working in progressively senior levels of responsibility at universities and international environmental organizations I had unique opportunity to serve various clients, ranging from governmental institutions, academia, non-governmental organizations and business.

Do you need guidance from a professional? Contact me today and explore how I can serve your needs.

items.name: Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA)
items.body: While working in the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe I had the unique opportunity to cooperate with Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA), headquarter in Stockholm; Sweden, on various programmes: supporting environmental civil society organizations, equipping local communities with powerful tools and skills for environmental action planning, water management and local water security action planning, etc.

items.name: European Centre for Nature Conservation (ECNC)
items.body: With European Centre for Nature Conservation (ECNC), headquarter in Tilburg, Netherlands, I’ve worked on development methodology for local biodiversity action planning. Communities that used methodology become champions of change for sustainability in beneficiary countries and the region, providing an opportunity for other communities to replicate their work and ecosystem services experience, including combating effects of climate change. Note: ECNC ceased operations in 2017.

items.name: Emisoft
items.body: For several years I’ve worked with Emisoft to establish the Environmental Management Centres (EMC) in Balkan countries. In Serbia, our work resulted in setting up an efficient emission monitoring and reporting platform within Serbian Agency for Environmental Protection (SEPA).

items.name: GIZ
items.body: My professional network also includes Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ). Within the GIZ-commissioned project Development of Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans for Selected Local Self-government Units in the Western Balkans, I led the country expert team Serbia supporting the preparation of Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans (SECAPs), coordinating expert contributions to local energy and climate action planning.

items.name: Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster (ABGC)
items.body: Member of the Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster (ABGC), contributing expertise in blue economy governance, skills development and stakeholder engagement. Supporting cooperation among academia, public authorities, businesses and civil society to promote innovation, knowledge exchange and sustainable development across the Adriatic region.

items.name: Young Researchers of Serbia
items.body: From January 1989 to December 1995, I served as Chairperson of the NGO network Young Researchers of Serbia, based in Belgrade. My engagement focused on environmental protection and sustainable community development through the application of scientific knowledge, educational programmes and volunteering, reflecting the organisation’s mission to be a driving force for positive social change.

items.name: E3 Consulting, Podgorica, Montenegro
items.body: Since September 2026, I have collaborated with E3 Consulting, Podgorica, as Key Expert and Team Leader supporting Montenegro’s Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management within the REDEEM project (Resilience in Desertification and Drought for Mediterranean). I coordinate technical delivery, integrate specialist contributions and act as the Ministry’s principal operational contact. My role combines expertise in the Water–Energy–Food–Ecosystems (WEFE) nexus and water governance with responsibility for methodology development, stakeholder engagement, quality assurance and reporting.

items.name: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
items.body:
Since December 2017, I have collaborated with the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, on projects spanning marine biodiversity conservation, blue economy development and sustainable innovation. I served as Project Manager for MonteAqua, focused on establishing the Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center “Boka Aquarium”, and EXChAngE, dedicated to exploring cross-border aquatic biodiversity.

Within SKILLS, I contributed expertise in policy analysis, stakeholder engagement, communication, and monitoring and evaluation. My ongoing collaboration includes serving as Blue Growth Collaboration Platform Expert for BLUECONNECT and Senior Advisor for Blue–Green Innovation and Collaboration Platforms for SATECON, supporting cross-border cooperation, knowledge exchange and connections between research and business.

items.name: Chamber of Commerce of Montenegro
items.body: From September 2024 to September 2026, I collaborated with the Chamber of Commerce of Montenegro as an Expert in Living Responsible Research and Innovation Ecosystems (LiRRIEs) and Inclusive Circular Economy (ICE) within the AZA4ICE project. My work focused on supporting stakeholder cooperation and applying responsible research and innovation principles to circular aquaculture, contributing to the project’s aim of advancing an inclusive circular economy.

items.name: Tourism Organisation of Kotor, Montenegro
items.body: From May 2024 to January 2025, I collaborated with the Tourism Organisation of Kotor as a Tourism and Conservation Specialist within the TOUR project (TOURists friends of the environment). My contribution focused on connecting sustainable tourism with environmental conservation, promoting responsible visitor practices and supporting approaches that balance tourism development with the protection of local natural assets.

items.name: ibf expertise, Brussels, Belgium
items.body: From October 2023 to April 2024, I collaborated with ibf expertise, Brussels, as Country Expert Team Leader for Serbia within the EU4 Energy Transition: Covenant of Mayors in the Western Balkans and Türkiye (EU4ETTR) project. Commissioned by ibf expertise under its contract with GIZ, my assignment comprised 25 working days of expert input. My contribution focused on coordinating national expert support and assisting Serbian municipalities in developing Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans (SECAPs), strengthening local capacity for energy transition and climate action.

items.name: Faculty of Biology, University of Belgrade, Serbia
items.body:
My collaboration with the Faculty of Biology, University of Belgrade, spans university teaching, scientific research and innovation leadership. From December 1989 to April 1996, I served as Teaching Assistant, conducting research in algal ecology and taxonomy and supporting student learning. During this period, I earned my PhD in Biology and received a UNESCO grant for hydrobiological research on Serbia’s Vlasina Reservoir.

As Assistant Professor from April 1996 to June 2006, I taught hydrobiology, hydroecology, botany and related disciplines, contributed to curriculum development and led a water quality monitoring research team. I also managed the Botanical Garden “Jevremovac” from 1996 to 2000, strengthening its scientific, educational and biodiversity conservation roles.

From July 2019 to February 2023, I served as Director of the Faculty’s Innovation Center, leading research and innovation development, partnerships and knowledge transfer. Key contributions included developing a biodiversity monitoring methodology and leading the preparation of an Ecological Network Impact Assessment study for planned wetland revitalisation in three protected areas in Serbia: Zasavica, Jegrička and Bara Trskovača.

items.name: Faculty for Applied Ecology, Belgrade, Serbia
items.body: From October 2006 to April 2017, I served as Associate Professor at the Faculty for Applied Ecology in Belgrade, Serbia. I taught Water Pollution and Protection, Eco-hydrology, and Sustainable Development and Environment, connecting scientific principles with practical environmental challenges. Alongside teaching, I contributed to curriculum development and developed an e-learning programme to support flexible access to environmental education.

items.name: Asenvirocon doo Kotor, Montenegro
items.body:
I founded Asenvirocon d.o.o. in Kotor, Montenegro, in April 2021 and served as Director until April 2025. I led the company’s project development and management services, covering concept development, proposal preparation, partnership building and coordination of multidisciplinary teams for national and international projects funded by the EU and other donors.

Alongside project consultancy, I supported the digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises through advisory services and the development of digital tools and online platforms to improve business efficiency, visibility and competitiveness. My ownership and directorship concluded in April 2025, when I sold my shares in the company.

items.name: Ministry of European Integration, Government of the Republic of Serbia
items.body: From September to December 2018, I served as an Independent Assessor for the Ministry of European Integration, Government of the Republic of Serbia. I assessed 11 project proposals under Priority Axis 3: Environment within the second Call for Proposals of the Interreg-IPA Cross-border Cooperation Programme Bulgaria–Serbia 2014–2020, financed through the Instrument for Pre-accession Assistance (IPA II).
